fields: stats.fpsAmmo.identity fields <- fps_blueprints ammoClass/family/variantName/variantCount (safe; existing index identity fields)
stats.fpsAmmo.compatibleWeaponFamily <- magazine AttachDef@Tags compatible family token (caution; local tag metadata, not display name)
stats.fpsAmmo.compatibleWeaponClass <- class token parsed from compatibleWeaponFamily tag (caution; local tag transform, not display name)
stats.fpsAmmo.damage* <- AmmoParams DamageInfo components (safe; parse number)
stats.fpsAmmo.damageType <- non-zero AmmoParams DamageInfo components (caution; derived label)
stats.fpsAmmo.alphaDamageTotal <- sum of AmmoParams DamageInfo damage components (caution; derived)
stats.fpsAmmo.projectileLifetimeTravel <- AmmoParams speed * lifetime (caution; derived travel distance, not usable range)
stats.fpsAmmo.calculatedRange <- projectileLifetimeTravel (deprecated compatibility alias; not usable range)
stats.fpsAmmo.hardRange/effectiveRange remain null (ammo params do not define usable weapon range by themselves)
stats.fpsAmmo.falloffStart <- damageDropMinDistance (safe; direct damage drop start when present)
stats.fpsAmmo.damageDropMinDistance <- AmmoParams damageDropParams/BulletDamageDropParams/damageDropMinDistance/DamageInfo active damage component (safe; direct distance value by damage type)

stats.fpsAmmo.damageDropPerMeter <- AmmoParams damageDropParams/BulletDamageDropParams/damageDropPerMeter/DamageInfo active damage component (safe; direct decimal damage-per-meter value by damage type)
stats.fpsAmmo.damageDropMinDamage <- AmmoParams damageDropParams/BulletDamageDropParams/damageDropMinDamage/DamageInfo active damage component (safe; direct minimum absolute damage by damage type)
stats.fpsAmmo.specialEffect remains null (no direct final special-effect field identified)
stats.fpsAmmo projectile/damage fields joined via magazine SAmmoContainerComponentParams@ammoParamsRecord -> AmmoParams@__ref (foundry/records/ammoparams/fps/none_rifle_ballistic_01_ammo_7mm.xml)
warnings: FPS ammo blueprint entityClass values join to magazine EntityClassDefinition.__ref records, then magazine ammoParamsRecord joins to FPS AmmoParams XML
compatibleWeaponFamily is a local magazine AttachDef tag, not a localized display family; compatibleWeaponClass is parsed from that local tag
damageDrop* fields are DamageInfo vectors; values use the active damage component, or summed components only for mixed damage types
damageDropPerMeter is stored as a decimal value, not converted to a displayed percentage
bullet impulse falloff is separate from damage falloff and is not used to calculate damage drop
calculatedRange is retained only as a deprecated compatibility alias for projectileLifetimeTravel and must not be treated as effective or hard range
quality modifier properties are indexed as tokens only, not final stats
specialEffect remains null without a direct final special-effect source field
